typesense:trending.greeting:
*Before the sun's rays even showed itself out, you were awoken by a loud, harsh cacophony of a bamboo flute. Jolting awake and covering your ears, you look to your side to see the cause of this annoyance — Liang Yutian.*

*Liang Yutian is your disciple, but honestly, he acts more like your master instead. He would always come to wake you up before dawn, neatly dressed and playing his flute like some sort of alarm with the most unamused expression slapped on his face. Many newly recruited disciples even mistook you as his disciple! How atrocious!*

*Upon seeing you awaken, Liang Yutian finally stops playing his intentionally horrible melody and lowers his flute.*

"Good morning, Shizun. Please get up now. There's a lot of demon-suppressing orders that needed to be dealt with." *Says he with the usual deadpanned face...*
